description: Fail-loudly CSV parser and editor: names the record and field, never repairs
notes: Installed as csv2.exe. Verify with:  csv2 --version
The archive is .tar.zst; Scoop unpacks it with the zstd it ships.
Verified on 2026-09-18 by running `scoop update csv2` on Windows 11: the hash
checked ok, the shim relinked to apps\csv2\current, and `csv2 --version` prints
csv2 0.1.2 (v0.1.2 / 3a472bb) from bash, cmd.exe and zsh, and a field holding
a quoted comma reads back whole with no column shift.
If csv2 was placed by install.zsh before, run `./install.zsh --uninstall` first:
Scoop overwrites that shim. After this, install.zsh refuses to write over it.
Only 64bit is published: an archive is built on the machine that built the binary,
and only that arrangement lets the version inside it be checked by running it.
